name: review
description: Code review by Codex, Claude and other engines through one helper with a pre-send secret scan, run twice in parallel by autoreview-pair (autoreview), and review that has to survive refutation: a multi-lens review where every finding faces three independent refuters before it counts (adversarial-review), a real-LLM canary harness proving an MCP server or tool surface cannot leak its secrets (mcp-agent-safety), and a fresh-context advisor in its own tmux window that can relay advice back to the primary agent (fable-second-opinion)
